Red-flag note 'work outside two listed files' — `client/src/lib/focusDuration.ts` and `focusDuration.test.ts` are explicitly authorized by Step 9 refactor (rule of three); not scope creep.

strengths: Duration is derived from `runningSince` via `computeDisplaySeconds` on every render; the 1s interval only bumps a re-render counter (`FocusTimer.tsx:28-44`, `focusDuration.ts:14-24`) — satisfies the sandwich-context anti-pattern guard against tick-counted duration.
Interval gated on `session.state === "running"` with cleanup in effect return; Paused and Ready tests assert `vi.getTimerCount() === 0` after 10 minutes (`FocusTimer.test.tsx:64-90`, `92-110`).
All DELIVERABLE control scenarios covered with exact spec copy ('Start', 'Pause', 'Resume', 'Finish focus') and `getByRole('button', { name })` assertions (`FocusTimer.test.tsx:113-252`).
Presentational boundary respected: props-only API, no `api` import, no `useFocusSession` (`FocusTimer.tsx:5-12`).
Step 9 extraction to `focusDuration.ts` with dedicated unit tests for `MM:SS` and `H:MM:SS` formatting plus `computeDisplaySeconds` edge cases (`focusDuration.test.ts:4-31`).

Styling aligns with creative brief via Tailwind theme tokens: `text-xl` duration readout, `text-sm` buttons, `rounded-md` (6px), primary/secondary button classes with correct disabled and focus-visible rings (`FocusTimer.tsx:14-18`, `48-103`).
Commit message matches conventional format: `feat(focus): add focus timer display and lifecycle controls` (7082bfa).

issues.description: No explicit unmount test verifying the running interval is cleared on component unmount; cleanup is implemented via `useEffect` return but only absence-of-interval in non-running states is asserted.

`finished` session state is accepted by `computeDisplaySeconds` but `FocusTimer` renders no controls and has no test coverage; acceptable for T8 scope (page wiring is T9) but worth a follow-up assertion that illegal controls stay hidden.
Root `npm run test` pass depends on server test env (`.env` present in audited worktree); fresh clones without `server/.env` may fail server suite unrelated to T8 client changes.
